app.name: Snes9x GX ULTIMATE
app.long_description:
Snes9x GX ULTIMATE by Repliroid do Futuro (VrepliroidV), based on Snes9x TX, a fork of Snes9x GX.
This build also reads Xbox 360 (XInput) USB controllers and 2.4 GHz receivers plugged into the Wii, as GameCube controllers. L + Select + Start opens the menu. PNG bezels around the game in 480i/480p, Auto Crop of black borders, automatic CPU overclock, per-game settings, Game Genie and Action Replay codes typed in the cheats menu, region option NTSC (Lie to PAL). Menu music from the music folder, with a mini player.
Authors: Snes9x GX ULTIMATE by Repliroid do Futuro (VrepliroidV). Snes9x TX by Tanooki. Snes9x GX by Tantric (on GameCube also SoftDev, crunchy2, Eke-Eke and others). Snes9x by the Snes9x Team.
